description: Record number assigned by the VizieR team. Should Not be used for identification.
? GALAH Field ID (-1 if not available) (field_id)
Right ascension (J2000) propagated from Gaia DR3 (ra)
Major spectroscopic fitting quality bitmask flag (flag_sp_fit)
Nr of optimisation loops used for fitting (opt_loop)
Quality bitmask flag of reduction pipeline (flag_red)
? Average signal-to-noise ratio (per pixel) of CCD1 (snr_px_ccd1)
? Average signal-to-noise ratio (per pixel) of CCD2 (snr_px_ccd2)
? Average signal-to-noise ratio (per pixel) of CCD3 (snr_px_ccd3)
? Average signal-to-noise ratio (per pixel) of CCD4 (snr_px_ccd4)
Percentage of spectrum used for spectroscopic fit (px_used_perc)
Neural network model used for creating synthetic spectra (model_name)
Neural network model closest for Teff/logg/[Fe/H] combination (closest_model)
? Radial velocity of potential secondary source (rv_comp_2)
? Barycentric velocity applied to reduced spectra (v_bary_eff)
? Surface gravity adjusted via parallax information (logg)
? Abundance of Fe and all other elements not fitted in GALAH (Fe: 1D-NLTE) (fe_h)
? 16th perc. radial velocity of fit to syn-obs residuals (sb2_rv_16)
? 50th perc. radial velocity of fit to syn-obs residuals (sb2_rv_50)
? 84th perc. radial velocity of fit to syn-obs residuals (sb2_rv_84)
? Equivalent Width of observed Hbeta core (ew_h_beta)
? Equivalent Width of observed Halpha core (ew_h_alpha)
? Residual Equivalent Width of syn-obs residuals at Hbeta core (res_h_beta)
? Residual Equivalent Width of syn-obs residuals at Halpha core (res_h_alpha)
? Equivalent Width of fit for K7699 Interstellar Line (ew_k_is)
? Sigma of Gaussian fit for K7699 Interstellar Line (sigma_k_is)
? Radial velocity of fit to syn-obs residuals around K7699 line (rv_k_is)
? Equivalent Width of fit for 5780 Diffiuse Interstellar Band (ew_dib5780)
? Sigma of Gaussian fit for 5780 DIB (sigma_dib5780)
? Radial velocity of fit to syn-obs residuals around 5780 DIB (rv_dib5780)
? Equivalent Width of fit for 5797 Diffiuse Interstellar Band (ew_dib5797)
? Sigma of Gaussian fit for 5797 DIB (sigma_dib5797)
? Radial velocity of fit to syn-obs residuals around 5797 DIB (rv_dib5797)
? Equivalent Width of fit for 6613 Diffiuse Interstellar Band (ew_dib6613)
? Sigma of Gaussian fit for 6613 DIB (sigma_dib6613)
? Radial velocity of fit to syn-obs residuals around 6613 DIB (rv_dib6613)
? Mean Gaia DR3 G-band apparent magnitude (phot_g_mean_mag)
? Mean Gaia DR3 GBP-band apparent magnitude (phot_bp_mean_mag)
? Astrometric parallax used for GALAH DR4 (parallax)
? Uncertainty on astrometric parallax used for GALAH DR4 (e_parallax)
? Median Distance used for calculating logg (plx) (r_med)
? Lower Limit Distance used for calculating logg (plx) (r_lo)
? Higher Limit Distance used for calculating logg (plx) (r_hi)
? Attenuation in Ks-band A(Ks) used for calculating logg (plx) (a_ks)
? Bolometric Correction Ks, BC(Ks), used for calculating logg(plx) (bc_ks)
? Bolometric Luminosity used for calculating logg (plx) (lbol)
